notes.camera_track: None. `.screen-world` is untransformed for the whole scene and carries no id — the in-phone camera was withdrawn on 18/08 and legibility is bought with frame real estate instead.
notes.carrier: The phone is the film's carrier. This is the film's one sanctioned reposition of the paragraph: nudge-curve x 0 -> 340px (34 / 255 / 340 at 0.14 / 0.12 / 0.44s, tail 3.1x the ramp-in) at t=1.90s, landing the device at true frame centre where it STAYS through frames 11 and 12. Translation only — the device never rescales.
notes.retime: 15s -> 12s (19/08). The cut is taken out of the approach: the type runs are shorter (store 'FOX' is 3 characters, not 8) and the dead gaps between the form beats are gone. The nudge-curve keeps its full 0.70s shape and the submit keeps its full press-release-spring, because those are what hand the paragraph to frame 11.
